association.interval_choice: Second cached 10-minute chunk on each source, chosen by availability before new scores
association.distance_settings: Two settings per representation: development positive-distance quantiles 0.90 and 0.97, clipped [0.02,1.8]. HSV uses half L1; R1/R2 cosine. Shared normalized appearance cost30 and gap-distance ratio3/7.
association.selection: Lower mean switch rate, <=1pp per-source consistent-history loss, <=5%+1 fragmentation, no increase pooled false scorable gap relinks. Production baseline unchanged.
association.repair: Only last valid feature and its own timestamp retained; finite0.8s expiry, no missing-crop timestamp refresh. Original cosine/gap/motion/margins unchanged for repair ablation.

population: All stable-key indexed seven-class labeled queries if measured throughput permits. Otherwise deterministic per-match/half/class hash-ranked sample fixed before full predictions; record inclusion weights. No prediction-based selection.

history.initialization: Identical bounded causal prefix up to8s,41samples at0.2s, native query grid offset preserved; empty memory/provider at prefix start. Not full-half continuous memory.
history.visibility: Existing SyntheticObservationProvider seed42, FOV120, range45m, dropout enabled; generate clean once, hold schedule fixed across corruptions.
history.injection: Released Observation measurements before CausalMemory; labels and target positions stored only in separate scorer context.
history.focal_query: Original runtime actor token always retained; no relink of fragmented actor or substitution.
history.g1_targets: Fixed clean hidden, seen-in-last2s memory targets with available annotation-derived query position; immutable track+segment. Model output scored via original runtime token, never nearest-neighbor or new-ID oracle repair.
history.attributes: Team/role stay with physical measurement during ID swaps; no oracle history correction. Slot overflow and unknown contracts explicitly counted.
history.models: Release default G1 and original S4; no G1 estimates in S4 input.

conditions.pairing: Current visible nonfocal observations, deterministic disjoint eligible pair matching; active swaps reserve endpoints. Same seeded opportunities across rates; starts independent of event labels/model outputs.
conditions.gap_recovery: Same original runtime ID returns after duration; preserve required11sample warmup.
conditions.fragment_recovery: None within prefix; new runtime ID is not a repaired original actor.
conditions.independent_noise: Radial RMS metres; independent XY Gaussian sigma=magnitude/sqrt2 per observed player-time.
conditions.common_translation: Fixed shared vector of norm magnitude for entire prefix, seeded direction, visibility held fixed; absolute vs actor-relative errors reported separately.
conditions.shared_drift: Causal OU shared displacement, time constant5s, stationary radial RMS magnitude, initialized0 at bounded prefix start. Not a calibrated real camera error model.
conditions.optional_source_level: Only if core complete with time; otherwise explicitly NOT_RUN, no full-camera robustness claim.

tolerance.interpretation: Provisional engineering criteria, not scientific standards or source certification. Missing availability criterion or inadequate clean quality cannot be hidden by survivor accuracy.
tolerance.uncertainty: Paired60s temporal-block bootstrap within half,200resamples; per-match/seed curves. Overlapping windows are not independent; two retrospective matches not population certification.
